title: clematis ochotensis subsp. coerulescens
intro: Clematis ochotensis subsp. coerulescens, commonly known as the Siberian clematis, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. Traditionally, the plant has been used in medicine to treat various health conditions due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Clematis ochotensis subsp. coerulescens involve its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
